title: Flottila *.test.yaml, schemaVersion 1 (draft — review at hand-over, P0-12)
description: Mock bindings and test cases for one flow (ARCHITECTURE §11). Behaviours use one vocabulary for every component: reply, recorded, script, files, messages, fail, delay; capture is always on.

reply.description: Fixture file the mock replies with: a path from the package root (D-078).

recorded.description: Response captured in monitoring, by reference.

files.description: Consumer side: fixture files to feed (glob from the package root, D-078); its folder is in the package.

messages.description: Consumer side: fixture messages to feed, as files are (D-080); never beside files.

after.description: the failure applies from the N-th send on (1 = from the first).

every.description: of the sends the failure applies to, every N-th fails.

sent.description: What the mock of one endpoint received (D-080): count = its sends, retries included; equals or contains must hold for every send, on the value of xpath, or without xpath on the body as UTF-8. An entry checks something: xpath only with equals or contains.

case.description: A case sends (send) or its flow's from endpoint is fed (files or messages in the effective mocks: the case's entry replaces the document's); status and error need a send (D-080, crossCheck).

send.description: Fixture to send: a path from the package root (D-078); optional when the from endpoint is fed.

sent.description: Endpoint id → what its mock received (D-080).
